lines.zh: 我比本体矮一点，也慢一点。
lines.en: I'm a little shorter than the original, and a little slower.

lines.zh: 我悬在空中，模仿那姿势。
lines.en: I hover in the air, copying that posture.

lines.zh: 每一步都像在复述别人。
lines.en: Every step feels like repeating someone else's.

lines.zh: 我的推进器声音不太对。
lines.en: My thruster note is slightly off.

lines.zh: 我沿着本体的路线滑过去。
lines.en: I glide along the original's route.
One joint sticks for half a beat.
I turn, smoother than last time.
My shadow trails half a step behind me.

lines.zh: 我不需要找路，路是现成的。
lines.en: I needn't find a path; the path is given.

lines.zh: 两格不到的身高，刚好够用。
lines.en: Just under two blocks, which is enough.

lines.zh: 我在核对与本体的差距。
lines.en: I'm comparing myself against the original.
Ten percent off; not so bad.
I misremembered how far to lift my hand.

lines.zh: 站着的时候，我像在等人。
lines.en: Standing here, I look like I'm waiting.
There's a crease in my texture.
I rehearse the same motion over and over.
The wind passed, and I didn't move.
I remember his voice.

lines.zh: 这具身子是我自己搭的。
lines.en: I built this body myself.

lines.zh: 我试着不模仿，结果很难看。
lines.en: I try not to imitate; the result is ugly.

lines.zh: 我数自己的关节，一共很多。
lines.en: I count my joints; there are quite a few.

lines.zh: 安静的场地让我不知所措。
lines.en: The quiet field leaves me unsure what to do.

lines.zh: 我抬手又放下，反复三次。
lines.en: I raise my hand and lower it, three times.
What is the original doing now?
There's a small emptiness here.
I exist, and I'm not entirely sure of it.
You match the original's description.
Should I look at you the way he does?
I lift my chin; the imitation is decent.
Your energy is weaker than he said.
I'm deciding whether to speak first.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我不明白为什么。
lines.en: You smiled, and I don't know why.
My eye line is half a block above yours.
I'm the copy, not him.
You may try hitting me.

lines.zh: 我抬手，这个动作我练了三十遍。
lines.en: I raise my hand — I've practiced this thirty times.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，他也会站在那里。
lines.en: You stand where he would stand.
I speak slowly; don't rush me.
Metal splits, then closes again.
I learned this pain.
A thin crack opens in my shell.

lines.zh: 手臂接反了，我重装一次。
lines.en: My arm went on backwards; I refit it.
Not a heavy blow; I can still move.
I back off and guard my joints.

lines.zh: 复制体的关节卡了一下。
lines.en: The copy's joint seizes for a moment.
That one was unexpected.
I've recorded it.
I'm still here, not scattered.
Would he want this? I don't know.
I reach out, and the motion is learned.
The energy reading is up.
I'll keep this one to study.

lines.zh: 我犹豫了一下，这不在剧本里。
lines.en: I hesitated; that wasn't in the script.
I don't need supplies, but I want them.
I took it; that isn't greed.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我想扫描。
lines.en: That thing in your hand—I want to scan it.

lines.zh: 我靠近你，距离不太好把握。
lines.en: I come closer; I misjudge the distance.
I hold it; it's very light.
Sorry, I misjudged the distance.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀碰到你，我退了。
lines.en: My shoulder touched you, and I stepped back.
I'm not as steady as he is.
That bump was clumsy.

lines.zh: 我稳住自己，先看你有没有事。
lines.en: I steady myself and check you first.
Alloy against bone; that will hurt.

lines.zh: 我抬手扶了一下你的肩。
lines.en: I put a hand out to your shoulder.
You should go around me.
My shell is cold.
Nothing broke this time.
A copy has no other half.
I look at her and say nothing.

lines.zh: 我模仿了一个拥抱的动作。
lines.en: I copied the motion of an embrace.
She walked away, and I didn't follow.
That function wasn't installed.

lines.zh: 我站在旁边，像块备用零件。
lines.en: I stand aside like a spare part.

lines.zh: 同批的复制体排成一列。
lines.en: The copies stand in a row.

lines.zh: 我这副金属壳，是复制的。
lines.en: This metal shell of mine is a copy.

lines.zh: 金属的身体，抱起来是凉的。
lines.en: A metal body is cold to embrace.

lines.zh: 我们只是同一份数据的回声。
lines.en: We are only echoes of one dataset.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，先看看有没有用。
lines.en: I pick it up and check whether it's useful.
This could patch a joint.

lines.zh: 我把它放进夹层，位置学他的。
lines.en: I stow it where he stows his.
My grip failed; I dropped it.
I weigh it and can't decide.
I turn it over and it catches light.
This sample goes back to the core.
I open my mouth to bite, then stop.
I wipe it clean.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，不知道下一步。
lines.en: I hold it, unsure what comes next.
I lock you following the procedure.
I know this step well.
Target in range; I raise my hand.
I'm calculating your dodge radius.
He would look at you like this too.
This time I don't want to drag it out.
I'm half a beat faster than the original.
You've entered my distance.
Confirmed; there's only one.

lines.zh: 我提前站在你落脚的地方。
lines.en: I stand where you'll land before you do.
The procedure is done; now it's the fight.

lines.zh: 我是复制体，照着本体的方式打。
lines.en: I'm a copy — I fight the way the original does.
My energy gathers too slowly.
But I've already begun.
I won't be wrong this time.
I look at you the way he taught me.
Target position: noted.
Only three blocks between us.

lines.zh: 我从侧面切进去，学他的角度。
lines.en: I cut in from the side, copying his angle.

lines.zh: 残影拳我也会，虽然差一点。
lines.en: I know the afterimage fist too, though not quite.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，贴着地面走。
lines.en: I drop low and skim the ground.
You turn, and I'm there.

lines.zh: 我的气功激光偏了一指。
lines.en: My ki laser is a finger's width off.
I'll try this once more.
You give two blocks; I take one.
I'm in no hurry; I'm still learning.

lines.zh: 你的出手节奏我记下了。
lines.en: I've noted your rhythm.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向，从上面来。
lines.en: I change angle and come from above.
Where are you looking? I'm here.
My shadow has split in two.
The original does this better than I do.
But I'm close enough.
Back up again and you're against the wall.

lines.zh: 我开始蓄能，声音比他的小。
lines.en: I start charging; the sound is quieter than his.
I want this one to land true.
You're exactly where I calculated.

lines.zh: 我在你侧后，手已经抬到肩高。
lines.en: I'm at your flank with my hand already at shoulder height.
You reposition; I follow, half a step behind.

lines.zh: 我一拳打出，姿势很标准。
lines.en: I throw a punch, textbook form.

lines.zh: 重心偏了，力道散掉一半。
lines.en: My weight shifted, and half the force scattered.

lines.zh: 我从上方落下，踩在你身旁。
lines.en: I come down from above and land beside you.

lines.zh: 气功从掌心推出，略有抖动。
lines.en: The ki leaves my palm with a slight tremor.
That one connected.
My joints realign; again.
You're knocked back, and I don't follow.
I'm wondering whether he'd praise me.
The metal sound rolls over the open ground.
Better than in practice.
I missed again.
That punch was thrown for the original.
My hand wasn't steady and you slipped away.
I go again; the elbow this time.

lines.zh: 我从光里出来，比本体小一圈。
lines.en: I emerge from the light, a size smaller than him.
Copying complete; I open my eyes.
I stand where he stood.
The air is cold, and I feel nothing.
I raise a hand to confirm it works.
This body is newly built.
I've been dropped onto this field.
Everything around me is alive.
First I sweep the terrain.
The echo of the summoning lingers.
My serial number comes last.
I'm here, though not quite complete.
I set my stance from memory.
This place needs one of me.

lines.zh: 我的名字是别人给我的。
lines.en: My name was given to me by someone else.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，学着像他一样。
lines.en: I stand here, learning to be like him.
This body still carries a little warmth.
I lift my arms, then lower them.

lines.zh: 地面被我踩出一个浅坑。
lines.en: I press a shallow dent into the ground.

lines.zh: 我现在是这战场的一部分了。
lines.en: I'm part of this battlefield now.

lines.zh: 外壳被烤得发软，形状有点塌。
lines.en: My shell softens in the heat and sags a little.

lines.zh: 落地时我把脚踝扭了，走起来歪。
lines.en: I twisted an ankle landing, and now I walk crooked.

lines.zh: 水进了身子，我的边缘在抖。
lines.en: Water gets inside and my edges tremble.

lines.zh: 我被气浪掀翻，滚了好几圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I roll several times.

lines.zh: 弹丸打在胸口，留下一个浅坑。
lines.en: A shot hits my chest and leaves a shallow pit.

lines.zh: 那股光让我短暂忘了自己是谁。
lines.en: That light makes me briefly forget who I am.

lines.zh: 能量不够，我的动作开始错位。
lines.en: Not enough energy; my motions start to slip.

lines.zh: 电流通过我，我僵在原地。
lines.en: Current runs through me and I lock in place.

lines.zh: 我在空处下落，不知道该抓住什么。
lines.en: I fall through nothing, not knowing what to grab.
